jobs.title: Lead / Senior AI Native Engineer - Java
jobs.description: We are looking for a Lead / Senior AI Native Engineer - Java to design, build, and scale agentic AI pipelines and enterprise Java systems, combining deep software engineering expertise with hands-on experience in multi-agent orchestration, MCP servers, and AI-native development practices. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable Java applications using Spring Boot and microservices architecture, owning features end-to-end with a high degree of autonomy Build and deploy MCP servers that expose Java services, databases, or internal tools to LLM-based agents, enabling agents to inspect, generate, and validate against live enterprise systems Build and extend the Agentic Workflow pipeline itself: orchestrator agents, producer agents, validator agents, and the skills that parameterize them, across the discovery, architecture design, and forward-engineering phases Onboard new client codebases, business domains, and target technology stacks onto the workflow by authoring technology adapters, stack-specific implementation skills, and section/validator skill pairs, without forking the core pipeline Design and implement agentic SDLC loops: automated specification drafting, AI-driven code generation, intelligent test creation, CI/CD integration, and deployment validation, each gated by deterministic scoring, dimension floors, and critical-issue auto-reject rules Integrate agentic pipelines with enterprise tools and platforms via MCP connectors or REST/event driven APIs Build React/Angular/JS frontends for modernized systems, reproducing legacy UI fidelity from wireframes and design tokens where the engagement requires 1:1 behavioral replication Use AI coding assistants and frontier LLMs across the full development lifecycle every day, critically evaluating AI outputs for correctness, security, and edge cases before committing Bring an AI-first mindset to automate repetitive engineering tasks, measure outcomes rather than activity, and identify AI leverage opportunities within the delivery area Contribute to the team's shared library of prompt templates, reusable agent patterns, skills, and MCP connectors so the next client, domain, or stack onboards faster than the last Conduct code and architecture reviews, and mentor Junior and Mid-level engineers in Java best practices and AI-native engineering methods Maintain strong automated test coverage and healthy CI/CD pipeline practices, and actively track frontier developments to bring relevant changes back to the team within weeks Requirements 6+ years of hands-on Java development in production environments, with strong proficiency in Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, and RESTful API design Working proficiency in React, Angular, or modern JS/TypeScript frameworks for production UI delivery Solid experience with microservices and event-driven patterns such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Cloud platform experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, including containerization with Docker and Kubernetes Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis) Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and DevOps engineering practices Active daily use of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) and frontier LLMs Hands-on experience building and deploying at least one MCP server exposing APIs, tools, or data sources to an LLM agent Demonstrated experience designing or implementing a multi-agent pipeline with distinct agent roles, explicit handoffs, and a pass/fail or scored quality gate between steps Experience authoring reusable, versioned skills or playbooks that encode domain/engineering judgment for agents to load Ability to integrate agentic pipelines with enterprise systems via MCP or REST/event APIs Capability to reverse-engineer requirements and domain models from legacy or unfamiliar codebases using AI-assisted analysis and translate them faithfully into a new target stack Practical context management skills, including prompt/context window structuring, retrieval and chunking strategies, and multi-step agent memory management Experience implementing AI guardrails such as input/output validation, PII redaction, hallucination and scope-of-action checks, and human-in-the-loop approval gates Working knowledge of tokenomics, including token usage/cost estimation, model selection trade-offs, and designing agent workflows within latency/cost budgets AI/LLM security awareness, including prompt-injection defense, secure handling of secrets/credentials, and least-privilege scoping for agent actions Strong critical evaluation skills for AI-generated code, identifying correctness issues, security gaps, and performance problems Genuine learning agility, with the ability to describe how engineering practice has evolved in the last 6–12 months due to new AI tools or model capabilities 8-12 Yrs Angular, Typescript, UI, MVC, Rest, Infrastructure, Production, Evaluation

jobs.title: Software Engineer- AI
jobs.description: Job Summary Software Engineer - AI; Remote India; Department: Engineering; Remote Full-time. We're building the next generation of conversational voice and video AI for life sciences-intelligent with 100% regulatory compliance. Our AI medical experts help pharma teams engage doctors, support patients, and unlock insights faster than ever before. We've just raised our seed, signed our first customers, and are scaling fast. If you're excited about building real-world AI in an early stage startup and shape not just our product, but our identity and culture - this is your moment. We move like owners. Everyone has the autonomy and the responsibility to drive projects, challenge decisions, and push things forward. We don't wait for permission. If you see a gap, you fill it. If you see a better way, you try it. We ask "why" until we get to the root. We explore new ideas, research papers, every single edge case and anything that sharpens our understanding. We use AI like a second brain. From writing code to writing docs, debugging flows to exploring new ideas, AI is part of our daily rhythm. Everyone here gets hands-on with the tools, learns how to prompt better, and treats AI as a teammate. About the Role We are looking for a hands-on Software Engineer ; who enjoys building end-to-end systems and shipping production-grade products. This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering, AI systems, and infrastructure. You'll work on LLM-powered and voice-enabled applications, integrate external APIs, and own services from design through deployment and operation. You'll join a small, fast-moving team building real-world software for healthcare and pharma, where reliability, performance, and correctness are non-negotiable. We value engineers who take ownership, move quickly, and are comfortable operating across the stack. What You'll Do Build and maintain backend services that power AI- and LLM-driven products Design and implement APIs, data flows, and service integrations Productionize LLM-based workflows (prompting, retrieval, orchestration, evaluations) Deploy and operate services with a focus on low latency, high availability, and robustness Design and manage infrastructure (containerization, cloud services, CI/CD) Work on voice-enabled systems (STT/TTS, streaming APIs) as part of end-user experiences Monitor, debug, and optimize systems for performance, reliability, and cost Collaborate closely with founders and product stakeholders to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable software Own features and services end-to-end, from initial design to production support What We're Looking For 2-5 years of experience in software engineering or backend-focused roles Strong proficiency in Python Experience designing and building APIs and backend systems Hands-on experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) Comfort with cloud infrastructure and DevOps fundamentals (Docker, AWS ECS/EKS/Lambda, observability, basic security) Interest in AI-powered systems, including voice and conversational interfaces Solid systems and architecture thinking, with a pragmatic approach to tradeoffs Ability to work with incomplete specs and make sound engineering decisions independently Job Details Location: Remote India Department: Engineering Work Arrangement: Remote Employment Type: Full-time Experience Level: Mid-senior-level Work Experience (years): 2 - 5 years Skills openai llms python 5-10 Yrs Lambda Expressions, Healthcare, Research, Docker, Architecture, Cloud, AWS, Debugging

Agentic AI / GenAI Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications beyond proofs of concept. jobs.title: Onboarding Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Role Overview Amagis Customer Experience team deliveto 50 linear channels every week to OTT, FAST, cable and smart-TV platforms around the world, and every delivery is quality-checked before it goes live. Today much of that QA is done by people watching streams for hours and checking EPG and metadata by hand. As an Onboarding Automation Engineer, you will design and build, from scratch, the automated testing system that does this work: a scalable, API-driven platform that checks video, audio, subtitles, ads, EPG and metadata the way a viewer would experience them. This is a software development role, not a manual testing role. You will build the system that the QA team uses, and you will own its adoption. You will sit within the QA team, work with Python, AWS, FFmpeg, OpenCV and AI models, and partner with delivery engineers, product and engineering. Within your first six months, the goal is a fully functioning system that tests video, SSAI, EPG and metadata for at least four tier-1 platforms. Location: Bengaluru What you will own Automated Delivery QA Platform: Design and build, from the ground up, an API-driven automated testing system that validates every linear channel delivery before it goes live. Define the test catalogue and pass/fail metrics with the QA team, and turn the requirements of close to 600 distribution platforms into configurable, reusable test cases, starting with tier-1 platforms such as Samsung TV Plus, LG Channels and Roku. Build pre-QA checks that catch stream, configuration and metadata errors before a delivery reaches QC, raising the first-time QA pass rate. Make the system easy for the QA and delivery teams to adopt: self-service test runs, clear reports, and integration with the tools they already use, such as Jira and Slack. Video, Audio, and Ad Validation: Detect visual defects the way a viewer sees them: black or frozen frames, pixelation and macroblocking, visible interlacing and other on-screen artefacts, using OpenCV and vision models rather than relying only on stream metadata. Build accurate, cost-effective detection of audio-video sync drift, where PTS timestamps alone cannot be trusted, along with missing or silent audio, channel layout and loudness issues. Validate closed captions and subtitles: presence, on-screen position, and timing against the audio. Validate SSAI and monetisation: SCTE-35 markers, ad break signalling, and whether ad replacement actually happens in the delivered stream. Check HLS and DASH streams against each platforms requirements: renditions, bitrates, codecs, resolution and manifest structure. EPG and Metadata Validation: Automate EPG and metadata checks across XMLTV, JSON and platform-specific formats: schedules, ratings, languages and required fields. Use OCR and vision models to validate artwork, for example whether an image carries the required title treatment, and whether titles and descriptions match what is actually playing. Bring existing validation scripts, such as the Roku EPG framework and the pre-QA checks on the delivery board, into the common platform. Scalable, Cost-Efficient Infrastructure: Architect the system on AWS so it scales out with delivery volume (40 to 50 channels a week and growing) and scales back when there is nothing to test. Process many concurrent streams efficiently, choosing between CPU, GPU, OpenCV and hosted AI models (for example through Amazon Bedrock) based on accuracy and cost per test. Containerise and deploy services with Docker, Kubernetes or serverless components, managed as infrastructure as code, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins). Add monitoring, alerting and logging so that failures in the platform itself are found and fixed quickly. Quality, Performance, and Reliability: Measure the accuracy of every automated check against human QA results, and drive down false positives and false negatives so the QA team trusts the system. Analyse recurring delivery and QC failures, and turn them into new tests and pre-checks. Keep historical reports and artefacts (HTML, JSON, recordings) for audit and debugging. Own the stability of the platform, maintaining 99.9% uptime. Collaboration and Reporting: Work with the QA lead and delivery engineers to prioritise test cases by business impact and platform. Track progress against a 30-60-90 day plan and give regular updates to your manager. Document the system and its APIs so other teams can add tests and plug it into their own workflows. What are we looking for 2-5 years of software development experience, with a track record of building backend systems or automation frameworks from scratch, not only writing test scripts. Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, including services, APIs and concurrent processing. Hands-on experience with video and audio analysis tools such as FFmpeg/FFprobe, MediaInfo and OpenCV. Working knowledge of streaming technologies: HLS, DASH, SRT, codecs, bitrates and adaptive renditions. Familiarity with server-side ad insertion (SSAI) and SCTE-35, or the ability to learn them quickly. Experience designing scalable, cost-efficient systems on AWS (EC2 Auto Scaling, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, SQS), and familiarity with AWS Media Services. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar), Git and Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD tools. Experience using AI/ML models, OCR, vision models or LLM APIs in production, and the judgement to know when they are accurate and cheap enough to use. Experience with REST APIs, JSON/XML schema validation, and a relational database such as PostgreSQL. Experience with monitoring and observability tools. The ability to reason about a problem from first principles, for example how to detect audio-video sync issues from the viewers side, and propose a practical, cost-effective solution. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to give regular status updates. Ownership mindset and the ability to work independently on a greenfield system in a fast-paced environment. Customer-focused mindset: you understand that a defect your system misses reaches a customers viewers. Good to have Experience with broadcast, OTT or FAST delivery, EPG formats such as XMLTV, smart-TV platforms or device test labs, and test frameworks such as Pytest or Robot Framework. jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer to design, build and maintain test automation for embedded products. You will write Python frameworks and C test code that run against real hardware, simulators and production firmware. You will work closely with firmware, hardware and system teams to catch defects early and make every release faster and safer. This is a senior, hands-on role. Lead the design of hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system-level test setups, including control of lab equipment (power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscopes, DAQs). Automate testing over communication interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Modbus and Ethernet. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitLab CI, Jenkins) and keep them fast and reliable. Define test strategy, test plans and coverage together with firmware, hardware and system engineers. Lead root-cause investigations of complex failures across firmware, hardware and system level. Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers, and lead code and design reviews. Evaluate new tools and technologies and drive improvements in test efficiency, stability and coverage. At least 5 years of hands-on experience developing in Python, including designing test frameworks or automation tools from scratch (e.g. pytest). At least 5 years of hands-on experience developing in C. Proven experience leading test automation for software that runs on hardware, from architecture to deployment. Strong background in software design, object-oriented design and clean, maintainable code. Deep understanding of software testing methods: unit, integration, system and regression testing. Experience with Git and CI/CD tools, including setting up and maintaining pipelines. Comfortable working in Linux environments and with scripting. Ability to read schematics and datasheets and use lab equipment for debugging. Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical work in a team. Good English, written and spoken. Advantages Experience with embedded systems, preferably from power electronics, automotive, robotics or similar industries. Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, simulators or test benches (e.g. dSPACE, NI, Typhoon HIL, Speedgoat). Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS) and bare-metal firmware. Knowledge of communication protocols such as CAN, Modbus, SPI, I2C, UART and Ethernet. Background in power electronics: inverters, converters, motor drives or battery systems. Team Engineering Leadership & Culture Talent Growth: Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of engineers and applied research scientists, cultivating an engineering culture that balances technical creativity with structured development practices and measurable product impact. Team Management: Proven experience managing, scaling, and leading technical teams focused on foundation models, multimodal systems, Generative AI, or applied machine learning operations. Education Academic Background: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field. An advanced degree is preferred. Technical Skills & Competencies Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Deep practical experience orchestrating containerized workloads using Kubernetes (K8s), managing distributed clusters, and configuring specialized GPU workloads, including NVIDIA NVLink and A100/H100 allocations. Model Serving & Inference: Hands-on experience optimizing model serving and runtime execution using enterprise frameworks such as Triton Inference Server, vLLM, or TGI to manage high-throughput, low-latency applications. Generative & Agentic Orchestration: Proficiency in building resilient, enterprise-grade AI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen. MLOps Lifecycle & Observability: Expert knowledge of the full ML lifecycle using MLflow or Weights & Biases for experiment tracking and model registries, alongside observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Arize, and TruLens for LLM tracking. Enterprise Infrastructure Fluency: Strong architectural knowledge of secure CI/CD pipelines, middleware, configuration management, and complex enterprise IT systems. Modality Execution: Experience handling and deploying model workflows across one or more modalities, including audio, speech, music, video, image, text, or multimodal systems. Leadership & Delivery Skills Clear Technical Communication: Ability to communicate technical trade-offs, runtime risks, and performance limitations effectively to both system administrators and executive leadership. Execution Focus: A proactive builder who takes ownership, handles infrastructure ambiguity, and prioritizes operational system stability. Delivery-Driven Prioritization: Ability to prioritize AI engineering investments based on technical feasibility, execution risk, compute costs, and actual customer adoption value. Target Metrics & Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The incoming manager will be directly accountable for the following operational and engineering benchmarks: Operational Stability & SLAs: Maintain at least 99.9% uptime SLA for core AI services, meet target p95/p99 latency thresholds, and limit production inference exception rates to less than 0.1%. Reduce prototype-to-production cycles (MLflow to Triton/vLLM) to less than 5 business days. Engineering Rigor & Code Quality: Enforce a minimum of 85% test coverage across core application layers, ensure zero critical vulnerabilities pass static analysis gates (SonarQube/Snyk), and maintain 100% peer-review compliance.
